Name: Krobus sells golden walnuts
Author: Lofi2musika
Description:
krobus now sells golden walnuts for 1000g in the sewer, this mod is intended for players who find the joja route takes too long and don't like obtaining them through the natural means. 

[size=4][u]What if i want to change the price? 
[/u][/size]1.open the mod folder
2. open the shop json file 
3. change the value to your decided price 

[size=5]*Requires Shop Tile Framework

[/size][size=3]This mod doesn't have an update key but if it breaks for some reason i'll update it, if you run into any problems let me know.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Makes golden walnuts available to purchase in Krobus's shop.
